title: 第19章 下放nbdl第20章 幸运的混蛋
content_zh:
第十九章 下放NBDL
“这赛季布兰德合同到期，很难留下了吧？马盖蒂如果打出了漂亮数据，也有可能跳出合同试水自由市场，我想快船到了重建的时候，这赛季应该果断摆烂，目标放在明年的选秀大会上，选中一名高顺位球员做为核心进行重建，再补强后卫线，未来才有希望。”
这其实算不上建议，在布兰德到来前，快船一直是擅长摆烂的球队。以快船现在的阵容，就算明年拿到状元签把罗斯选到洛杉矶，也不会强到哪里去，受影响最大的是公牛，没有罗斯不知道公牛还能不能成为一支强队。
聊了一会儿，留下对方的联系电话后，叶锋下楼去找妮娜了。此时他根本想不到，艾莉儿日后真的会利用他，而不是一句戏言……
这次舞会，叶锋和妮娜没擦出任何火花，就是普通朋友聚会。第二天他又开始进入忙碌状态，当晚湖人主场迎战第二个对手明尼苏达森林狼。
加内特离开后，森林狼堕落了，新狼王艾尔.杰弗森独木难支，湖人只用三节比赛就93比70遥遥领先将比赛变成了垃圾时间。叶锋第四节出场6分钟，贡献了一记扣篮，得到2分4篮板1盖帽。
正当人们开始关注叶锋，一个坏消息传出，图里亚夫复出了。叶锋被放入伤病名单，失去了替补出场的机会。
十一月十四日，NBDL发展联盟即将开赛。制服组又宣布将叶锋下放NBDL洛杉矶防守者队锻炼。
NBDL是NBA球队的人才库，属于二级联盟。被下放对球员来说是件郁闷的事，可叶锋觉得无所谓，他需要比赛。他上场时不敢随便出手，有了机会也犹豫。到了NBDL没大牌球员，就不用担心球权问题了。他肯定会获得出场时间，准备在场上多投篮找手感。只有练好中投，他才能获得更多的出场时间。
防守者队最初的主场球馆是与湖人相同的斯台普斯中心，今年8月刚刚迁往新落成的公民商业银行球场。
叶锋在大学里考出了驾照，季前赛后他买了一辆二手车，老版雪弗兰，样式古老，优点是便宜。他自己开车到了十公里外东部的公民商业银行球馆报道。
在球馆里，叶锋和临时队友们打了招呼，这些人都很羡慕他，他们不像叶锋是签约后被下放，只能慢慢等待进入联盟的机会，一般是从十天短合同开始打起，留下的可能性非常低。
NBDL也会有明星赛，最佳球员，最佳阵容的评选。可即使是成为发展联盟MVP，也未必就能加盟NBA，可见竞争的残酷。
拉芙林不仅是湖人球探，也是洛杉矶防守者队的副总经理。拉芙林向他介绍了球队教练马克，马克是名五十多岁的白人，身宽体胖，年轻时没有在NBA打球的经历，属于学院派教练。
意外的是，迪瓦茨也来到了这里。教练组专门让迪瓦茨这段时间来指导叶锋进攻，一个边缘球员能有助理教练跟随调教，足以见得湖人队对他的重视。迪瓦茨和马克进行了一番沟通，叶锋又得到了另一个好消息，防守人队会以他为核心进攻。
在湖人队内，叶锋总是进攻端最后的选择，成为进攻核心这种事只有做梦的时候能发生。为了让他进步，教练组给他提供了足够的便利。大体计划是让叶锋到高位挡拆，后卫队员要将球传回给高位，他可以在高位出手投篮，也可以选择传球。迪瓦茨还会教他一些低位进攻方式，增加他在进攻端的威胁性。
为了给母队储备所需人才，所有NBDL球队与所属NBA球队在战术打法，甚至防守策略上都一样。在这里训练，不会出现回到湖人不适应节奏的问题。
NBDL的比赛将在一周后开始，叶锋在迪瓦茨的安排下提高了训练量，提前开始了单人练习。迪瓦茨拿了一个篮球，一脸严肃道：“以你的身体素质，只要努力，肯定能在短期内提高，帮助球队，不要因为到了发展联盟就觉得会轻松一些，我来帮你特训只会比你在湖人训练时更累，你要做好心理准备。”
叶锋也正色道：“我训练的时候就没觉得累过，快开始吧！”
迪瓦茨很满意他的态度。“全面的低位进攻，高位策应和中投，就是你在这里要练习的东西，我会给你做示范，你看好了。”

迪瓦茨一边示范，一边进行起讲解。
低位进攻，所指的是球场上接近底线篮筐左右附近的位置，篮筐7尺距离左右的区域都可以称之为低位区域。篮球术语提到的低位进攻能力并非指球员的某一种技术，而是指球员在低位区域内得分和策应的能力，包括背对篮筐接球后的转身单打，直接背对篮移动中或者倚靠中投篮，还包含了转身走底线突破，背对篮筐接球然后分球空切队友等比较常用的内线动作。
除了极少数后卫或者小前锋外，一般在低位的都是大个子肌肉男。球场上对抗最激烈的当然是三秒区内！任何一名在三秒区内移动或者活动的进攻方队员都会受到对手特殊照顾。而最合适低位进攻的是速度和力量兼备的球员，这样才能在身体对抗比较强劲的情况下寻找得分机会，叶锋正是这种类型的人。
擅长低位进攻的人，也容易统治比赛。
首先，接近底线背对篮筐不容易受到包夹，即便是受到包夹，也就是形成了进攻方空位球员的射篮机会，可以立刻形成分球策应的局面，也正基于此，除非低位接球球员单打能力非常强导致防守方不得不采取包夹战术以外，大多数情况下，防守方只会适当缩小防守区域谨慎的对待此刻的低位持球球员是否进行单打。所以低位是一个比较容易形成内线一对一的区域。
其次，低位的球员由于背对防守球员，身体可以将防守方球员与球隔离，分球时不容易干扰，具有隐蔽性，并且视野开阔，可以以同时兼顾己方队友走底线或者中路空切的位置进行助攻。
最后一点，NBA的三秒区是面积为4.88米×5.8米的长方形，而国际篮联的三秒区是3.6米×6米×5.8米的梯形！NBA的三秒区较国际篮联的标准赛场规定要小，低位的要球点更接近篮筐，更易获得得分机会。
当然，NBA赛场上的低位并非防无可防，伴随着区域联防在NBA越来越盛行，低位单打难度有所增大，但是适应低位进攻的球员，对内线左右两侧的杀伤力都非常强，就算没有单打机会得分的概率也比一般球员来的高。
不少队伍经常采取两种防守方式。一种是在低位球员开始单打时刻仅仅是收缩防守区域，当进攻球员完成最后一个运球动作开始投篮动作的瞬间进行包夹干扰其命中率。第二是当低位进攻球员将要跨出最后一步或者形成转身的时候第二名防守球员直接挡其最后一步的位置，这是某种程度的陷阱防守，由于近年来优秀内线球员匮乏，这类看似技术含量不高的防守战术居然还颇为奏效。
除了战术上防守以外，单兵防守能力强的球员同样能够不通过队友帮助完成低位防守，比如加内特、邓肯、本华莱士这些球员基本上不会给进攻方摆脱自己直接面对篮筐的机会，迫使进攻球员在对抗中投篮而不是摆脱后投篮，叶锋之所以受到重视，就因为他的力量只比华莱士稍逊，速度，弹跳却更强。就算进攻能力一般，他也有希望成为一个超级防守人。
第二天，防守者队开始了第一次合练。
叶锋打的很轻松，迅速竖立起了信心。很少有“怪兽”级身体素质的人在这里打球，早些日子和他一起参加过季前赛训练营的艾尔顿.布朗，就称的上佼佼者。而在火箭当过几天临时工的哈里斯，在发展联盟几乎就可以呼风唤雨，无所不能。
洛杉矶防守者队都是些选秀失败的边缘人，球员投篮能力都不错，是NBA级别的，却很少有人擅长防守。球探们不会每天观看NBDL的比赛，只有漂亮的数据才能吸引NBA球队找他们试训。卖力的防守是很难获得数据的，还容易受伤，得不偿失，没人喜欢。
叶锋在迪瓦茨的指导下练了一招快速转身后底线扣篮或中路投篮，这一招他就打成了好几个。叶锋太快了，只要他转身成功，就能将球扣进篮筐。
叶锋靠着身体也能抢下不少的篮板球，拿下前场篮板，只要对手不犯规，他立即就上演暴扣。练了半小时，叶锋的表现是统治级的，他本以为迪瓦茨会夸奖自己一番，没想到迪瓦茨对他非常不满意。
“叶，你这种打法是浪费时间，起不到锻炼效果。NBA的防守可不会这么松懈，你要练的是投篮！从现在开始，我不想再看见你扣篮！不要再全力起跳！”
再回到场上，只能投篮的叶锋威力马上降了大半，禁止一个弹跳力非凡的人扣篮，是残酷的。

Chapter 19 Decentralization of NBDL
"Brand's contract expires this season, so it will be difficult to keep him, right? If Maggette produces good numbers, he may also jump out of the contract and test the free market. I think when the Clippers are rebuilding, they should decisively fail this season. The goal is to select a high-ranking player as the core for reconstruction in next year's draft, and then strengthen the back line. Only then will there be hope for the future."
This is not actually a suggestion. Before Brand arrived, the Clippers had always been a bad team. With the Clippers' current lineup, even if they get the No. 1 pick next year and draft Rose to Los Angeles, they won't be much stronger. The Bulls will be most affected. Without Rose, I don't know if the Bulls can still become a strong team.
After chatting for a while and leaving the other party's contact number, Ye Feng went downstairs to find Nina. At this moment, he never imagined that Ariel would really use him in the future instead of just making a joke...
At this dance, Ye Feng and Nina didn't create any sparks. It was just a gathering of ordinary friends. He started to get busy again the next day. That night, the Lakers faced their second opponent, the Minnesota Timberwolves, at home.
After Garnett left, the Timberwolves declined, and the new Wolf King Al Jefferson was unable to survive alone. The Lakers took a 93-70 lead in just three quarters, turning the game into garbage time. Ye Feng played 6 minutes in the fourth quarter and contributed a dunk, scoring 2 points, 4 rebounds and 1 block.
Just as people began to pay attention to Ye Feng, bad news came out that Turiaf was back. Ye Feng was placed on the injured list and lost the opportunity to come on as a substitute.
On November 14th, the NBDL Development League is about to start. The uniform team also announced that Ye Feng will be transferred to the NBDL Los Angeles Defenders for training.
The NBDL is the talent pool of NBA teams and is a second-tier league. Being demoted is a depressing thing for players, but Ye Feng thinks it doesn't matter, he needs to compete. He didn't dare to take a shot casually when he was on the court, and he hesitated when he had the opportunity. There are no big-name players in the NBDL, so there is no need to worry about ball rights. He will definitely get playing time and is ready to take more shots on the court to find his touch. Only by practicing his mid-range shooting can he get more playing time.
The Defenders' original home arena was the Staples Center, the same venue as the Lakers, and they just moved to the newly completed Citizens Bank Arena in August this year.
Ye Feng got his driver's license in college. After the preseason, he bought a second-hand car, an old version of Chevrolet. It has an old style and the advantage is that it is cheap. He drove himself to the Citizens Commercial Bank Arena ten kilometers away in the east to report.
In the gym, Ye Feng greeted his temporary teammates. These people all envied him. Unlike Ye Feng, who was transferred after signing the contract, they could only slowly wait for the opportunity to enter the league. They usually started with a ten-day short contract, and the possibility of staying was very low.
The NBDL will also have star games, best player, and best lineup selections. But even if you become the MVP of the Development League, you may not be able to join the NBA, which shows the cruelty of competition.
Laughlin is not only a Lakers scout but also the assistant general manager of the Los Angeles Defenders. Laughlin introduced him to team coach Mark. Mark was a white man in his fifties, wide and fat. He had no experience playing in the NBA when he was young and was an academic coach.
Unexpectedly, Divac also came here. The coaching staff specially asked Divac to guide Ye Feng's offense during this period. For a fringe player to have an assistant coach to follow him, it is enough to show that the Lakers attach great importance to him. Divac and Mark had some communication, and Ye Feng got another good news. The defensive team will attack with him as the core.
In the Lakers, Ye Feng is always the last choice on the offensive end. Becoming the core of the offense can only happen in dreams. In order for him to improve, the coaching staff provided him with sufficient conveniences. The general plan is for Ye Feng to go to the high post to pick and roll, and the defender has to pass the ball back to the high post. He canShoot from the high post, or pass the ball. Divac will also teach him some low-post offense methods to increase his threat on the offensive end.
In order to reserve the talent needed for the parent team, all NBDL teams have the same tactics and even defensive strategies as their NBA teams. When training here, there will be no problem of not adapting to the rhythm when returning to the Lakers.
The NBDL game will start in a week. Under Divac's arrangement, Ye Feng increased his training volume and started individual training in advance. Divac took a basketball and said with a serious face: "With your physical fitness, as long as you work hard, you will definitely improve in the short term and help the team. Don't think it will be easier just because you are in the Development League. I will help you with special training. It will only make you more tired than when you train with the Lakers. You have to be mentally prepared."
Ye Feng also said seriously: "I have never felt tired during training. Let's get started!"
Divac was pleased with his attitude. "Comprehensive low-post attack, high-post support and mid-range shooting are what you have to practice here. I will demonstrate it to you, so you can watch it."
Divac demonstrated and explained at the same time.
Low post offense refers to the position on the court near the bottom line and to the left and right of the basket. The area about 7 feet away from the basket can be called the low post area. The low-post offensive ability mentioned in basketball terminology does not refer to a certain skill of the player, but refers to the player's ability to score and support in the low-post area, including turning and singles after receiving the ball with the back to the basket, directly moving with the back to the basket or leaning on the mid-range shot. It also includes turning and walking to the baseline to break through, receiving the ball with the back to the basket and then passing the ball to cut teammates and other more common inside actions.
Except for a very few guards or small forwards, those in the low post are usually big, muscular men. The most intense confrontation on the court is of course the three-second zone! Any offensive player who moves or is active within the three-second zone will receive special care from the opponent. The most suitable players for low-post offense are players with both speed and strength, so that they can find scoring opportunities under strong physical confrontation. Ye Feng is exactly this type of person.
People who are good at attacking in the low post can easily dominate the game.
First of all, being close to the baseline with your back to the basket is less likely to be double-teamed. Even if you are double-teamed, it will create a shooting opportunity for the attacker's open player, and you can immediately form a ball-sharing situation. Based on this, unless the low-post receiving player is very strong in singles and the defense has to adopt double-team tactics, in most cases, the defense will only appropriately reduce the defensive area and carefully treat whether the low-ball player at the moment is performing singles. Therefore, the low position is an area where it is easier to form a one-on-one inside line.
Secondly, because the low-post player has his back to the defensive player, his body can isolate the defensive player from the ball. It is not easy to interfere when passing the ball. It is concealed and has a wide field of vision. He can assist his teammates while taking the baseline or cutting in the middle.
Last but not least, the NBA's three-second zone is a rectangle with an area of ​​4.88 meters x 5.8 meters, while the FIBA ​​three-second zone is a trapezoid of 3.6 meters x 6 meters x 5.8 meters! The NBA's three-second zone is smaller than FIBA's standard court regulations. The low-post goal point is closer to the basket, making it easier to get scoring opportunities.
Of course, the low post in the NBA is not defenseless. As zone defense becomes more and more popular in the NBA, the difficulty of low post singles has increased. However, players who are adapted to low post offense are very lethal to both the left and right sides of the inside. Even if there is no single opportunity, the probability of scoring is higher than that of ordinary players.
Many teams often adopt two defensive methods. One is to simply shrink the defensive area when the low-post player starts to play in isolation, and then double-team the offensive player to interfere with his shooting rate when he completes the last dribbling action and starts shooting. The second is when the low post offensive player is about to step out of the finalWhen a player takes a step or turns around, the second defensive player directly blocks his last step. This is a certain degree of trap defense. Due to the lack of excellent inside players in recent years, this type of seemingly low-tech defensive tactic is actually quite effective.
In addition to tactical defense, players with strong individual defensive capabilities can also complete low-post defense without the help of teammates. Players such as Garnett, Duncan, and Ben Wallace will basically not give the offensive team the opportunity to get rid of themselves and directly face the basket, forcing the offensive players to shoot during the confrontation instead of shooting after getting rid of it. The reason why Ye Feng is valued is because his strength is only slightly inferior to Wallace, but his speed and jumping are stronger. Even if his offensive ability is average, he still hopes to become a super defender.
The next day, the Defenders began their first practice together.
Ye Feng played very easily and quickly gained confidence. There are very few people with "monster" level physical fitness playing here. Elton Brown, who participated in the preseason training camp with him in the early days, is considered to be the best. And Harris, who has been a temporary worker in the Rockets for a few days, can almost call the shots in the Development League and is omnipotent.
The Los Angeles Defenders are all fringe players who failed in the draft. The players all have good shooting abilities and are at the NBA level, but few are good at defense. Scouts will not watch NBDL games every day. Only beautiful data can attract NBA teams to try out with them. It is difficult to get data if you defend hard, and you are prone to injuries. The gain outweighs the loss, and no one likes it.
Under the guidance of Divac, Ye Feng practiced a move that turned quickly and then dunked from the baseline or shot from the middle. He made several of this move. Ye Feng is so fast that as long as he turns around successfully, he can dunk the ball into the basket.
Ye Feng can also grab a lot of rebounds with his body and win offensive rebounds. As long as the opponent does not foul, he will immediately perform dunks. After practicing for half an hour, Ye Feng's performance was dominant. He thought Divac would praise him, but he didn't expect Divac to be very dissatisfied with him.
"Ye, your style of play is a waste of time and has no training effect. NBA defense will not be so lax. What you have to practice is shooting! From now on, I don't want to see you dunk again! Stop jumping with all your strength!"
Back on the court, Ye Feng, who could only shoot, immediately lost most of his power. It would be cruel to prohibit a person with extraordinary jumping ability from dunking.
